Chapter 699: Chapter 8: Aurora from Beyond the Universe (Subscribe Requested)

The grayish-purple gourd vibrated.

Streams of information flowed into Lin Yuan’s mind.

“So, after absorbing the seven liquids, there’s a follow-up…”

Lin Yuan rubbed his temples. The information transmitted by the grayish-purple gourd was scant.

To sum it up,

it was essentially this:

...

Following the seventh purple liquid, there was an eighth liquid.

But to condense this eighth liquid, there were requirements for both the physical body and the spatial aspect within.

The flesh had to reach the level of the Twelfth Rank while the inner space… had to transform into the scope of an Inner Universe.

Only a body and inner space of this caliber could support the amplification brought about by the eighth liquid.

“The Twelfth Rank level?”

“An Inner Universe?”

Lin Yuan was inwardly astonished; an existence that simultaneously met these two conditions was probably only a Supreme Being.

Among the myriad informations of the Profound Yellow Lineage, with the aid of numerous external secret techniques and specific fusion rules, there was a slim hope of elevating an Eleventh-Rank Life’s physical body to the threshold of the Twelfth Rank.

But an Inner Universe? It was only from striving for the ultimate, the Ultimate Leap, reaching the utmost sublimation, that there was hope to form it.

Even for Lin Yuan, his current inner world was far from meeting the minimum criteria for an Inner Universe.

Even with another infusion of Chaos Void Origin, causing the foundation of the inner world to soar several tiers,

it would still fall short compared to an Inner Universe.

The Inner Universe of a Supreme Being was the source of their power, their reliance to step beyond the River of Time, akin to a weakened version of the Main Universe.

“What is the origin of this gourd…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn as he observed the grayish-purple gourd floating before him.

Although he didn’t know what use the eighth liquid from the gourd had for the Inner Universe,

comparing to the effects the first seven liquids had on Lin Yuan’s own inner world, it was easy to deduce that even a Supreme Being would undergo some kind of transformation because of it.

And this was incredibly astonishing.

How high was the level of a Supreme Being? Some treasures and rare items have significant advancing effects on Tenth Rank Lives and Eleventh-Rank Lives.

But in front of a Supreme Being, they were commonly of little use.

Let alone transformation.

A treasure or rarity that could induce a transformation in a Supreme Being, at least Lin Yuan had never heard of such.

“I must secure the gourd well,” Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged.

Originally, Lin Yuan thought that the Mysterious Gourd was only effective for lives below the Twelfth Rank. Even so, its value far exceeded that of the Eternal Spring.

But now?

Even a Supreme Being could undergo a transformation with it.

The Mysterious Gourd’s value was immeasurable.

“Put it away?”

“Where to keep it?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly. He communicated with the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, placed the Mysterious Gourd into a space bracelet, and then sent it to the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Although Lin Yuan’s true body presided over the Milky Way Main Star, located within the territory of the Human Civilization, under the watchful eyes of Supreme Beings,

it was not completely foolproof.

For instance, if several Supreme Beings of different species were to join forces and come, it was possible that they could kill Lin Yuan and seize the Mysterious Gourd before the Supreme Beings of human civilization could respond.

Of course, this possibility was slim. How could such beings ally to strike at a mere Tenth Rank Life?

And with the presence of the Soul-Settling Pearl, the Supreme Beings of different species wouldn’t be able to completely kill Lin Yuan.

But the possibility remained.

Lin Yuan had to be cautious.

Placing the Mysterious Gourd into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, one could basically say it was completely secure.

At least since the Xuanhuang Secret Realm appeared, no Supreme Being had entered it yet.

To put the Mysterious Gourd in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was much safer than having it on Lin Yuan himself.

It would just be a bit more of a hassle to use it later.

But Lin Yuan didn’t mind.

…

The black planet.

The Life and Death Samsara Rule guided the space for the pathway.

An incarnation of Lin Yuan sat here, continuously observing the merger and alternation of life and death.

Almost every second, Lin Yuan gained new insights into the Life and Death Samsara Rule. His Against-Heaven’s Understanding, along with the guided pathway,

almost made his progress in cultivating this fusion rule soar.

“Sublime! Sublime! Sublime!”

“Who would’ve thought that life and death could combine in this way?”

Immersed in the process, Lin Yuan’s mind was filled with flashes of spiritual light.

For a normal Tenth Rank Life to have any enlightenment on pillar-level fusion rules, it would take an unknown amount of effort and sacrifice.

But for Lin Yuan now, it had virtually become a ‘daily’ affair.

“Life, it’s not simply about living.”

“Death is not just the end.”

The more Lin Yuan meditated, the deeper his understanding of these two rules became, and the deeper his comprehension of the Life and Death Samsara Rule grew.

The rules of Life and Death, if it were just one of them, would not be considered a very strong pillar rule.

But when fused, the power of Life and Death Samsara that burst forth suddenly made it one of the several fusion rules best known for its lethal force.

…

Code A076 Alien Race Battlefield.

Compared to the Large Alien Battlefield where Lin Yuan was,

this Large Alien Battlefield was a bit more intense. It brought together the Human Civilization, the Tianyu Clan, the Prison Tribe, the Insect Race, and other four Peak Clans.

The entire battlefield was akin to a meat grinder, with Eighth Layer and Ninth Rank powerhouses dying daily.

Even for a Tenth Rank powerhouse, without reaching Grade A, in the heat of a fierce battle, it was easy to fall.

Of course, the powerful individuals who dared to come to a Large Alien Battlefield generally only sent Avatars. However, the fall of an Avatar still significantly affected the True Body.

Uplifting an Avatar to be nearly as strong as the True Body required nearly as many resources as the True Body itself.

A Tenth Rank powerhouse who lost an Avatar would likely not recover for thousands or tens of thousands of years
